results.title: Sachin, Kohli, Rohit Contacted Retiring Ajinkya Rahane. He Told Them The Same Thing
results.description: As Ajinkya Rahane announced his retirement from cricket, Sachin Tendulkar was the first person to call him. Later, the likes of Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma exchanged text messages with him.

results.title: How much power does Josh Allen actually have inside the Buffalo Bills and is Joe Brady already in over his head?
results.description: NFL insiders report Josh Allen's extensive influence over Bills offensive decisions. This control over pass protections has reportedly caused staff frustration in past seasons. Allen also played a key role in selecting Joe Brady as the new head coach. Brady's prior success with Allen builds familiarity but presents a new dynamic. The upcoming season hinges on Brady establishing accountability with his star quarterback.
